title: MechWorks
description: Customize and pilot your own modular Mech Suit, have robots mine and tree farm for you, power advanced storage interfaces, and more!
body: # MechWorks **Build a mech. Arm it to the teeth. Automate everything else.** MechWorks is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that puts you in the cockpit of a customizable war machine — then hands you the worker bots, power grid, and logistics to run the whole operation. ![Two mech suits and a MechBot](https://i.imgur.com/4mvi7lt.png) *** ## 🤖 The Mech Craft a **Mech Chassis**, right-click the ground, and climb in. First person puts you behind a full cockpit HUD — targeting reticle, compass, energy and hull readouts, and a lock-on computer that paints targets near your reticle. _The cockpit: energy and armor rails, compass strip, velocity and altitude, your armament bound to each mouse button — and a chicken that has made a serious mistake, locked at 15 meters._ Nine hardpoints let you build the mech _your_ way: | Hardpoint |Options | | --------- |---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Arms (×2) |Drill · Quarry Drill · Blaster · Power Fist · Beam Saber · Gatling Gun · Texture Sprayer | | Shoulder |Missile Pod · Sentry Drone | | Legs |Jet Thrusters (+18% speed, higher jumps, V-key dash) | | Torso |Cargo Module / Vault / Hold (27–81 slots, paged) | | Head |Solar Helmet (trickle charge) | | Back |Mech Wings (true flight) | | Battery |Iron → Netherite (up to 4,000 E, half-price energy costs) | | Plating |Iron → Netherite (up to +10 armor / +6 toughness, adds a color trim) | The mech is a fortress: 160 HP, immune to wither and poison, no fall damage — big drops _ground-pound_ everything around you instead. A fully plated mech shrugs off a wither while the beam saber takes thirds off its health bar. **The arsenal:** homing blaster bolts when locked on, a 3-missile ripple salvo, a deployable laser sentry, a beam saber that swings like a sword and hits like a train (50 damage, 10s recharge), a gatling that trades accuracy for sheer volume, drills that chew 3×3 and 9×9 faces straight into your cargo hold — and a **Texture Sprayer** that weathers stonework into mossy and cracked variants for the builders. ![Mech GUI](https://i.imgur.com/tFiINJp.gif) Dye the accent paint any color. Install plating for a matching trim. Look good doing it. ## 🔧 MechBots Knee-high workers that dock to a **Charging Chest** and just… handle it: * **Forester** — plants a dense sapling grid, fells whole trees (branches included, however tall they grow), sweeps up every sapling and apple, banks the logs, and restocks its own saplings from the chest. * **X-Ray Miner** — scans a configurable radius down to bedrock, tunnels to ore, hauls it home, and flies back no-clip if it gets stuck. Gives up on unreachable ore instead of sulking. Bots are **chunk loaders**: your farm and mine keep running while you're a continent away — through server restarts. Sneak-click to pocket a bot, bag and all. ![A forester MechBot working its tree farm](https://i.imgur.com/fAj1MBv.png) ## ⚡ The Power Grid A complete standalone energy system speaking **Team Reborn Energy** (plays perfectly with Tech Reborn, but needs nothing beyond Fabric API): * **Photon Arrays MK-I → MK-IV** — solar generation from 1 to 64 E/t (config-tunable), with an onboard night buffer. * **Power Conduits** — six-way connecting cables that just work. * **Capacitor Banks MK-I → MK-III** — 200k to 3.2M E of storage. * **Charging Pad** — parks and charges mechs (and tops up your gauntlet while you stand on it). **Charging Chest** — bot dock, deposit box, and battery in one, with a proper swinging lid. ![Power Grid](https://i.imgur.com/0XF8Nus.png) ## 🖥️ The Access Terminal A crafting terminal over **everything adjacent to it** — point it at your chest wall and get one scrollable, count-sorted view of the lot. Click to pull, shift-click to pull stacks or deposit, and a 3×3 crafting grid that **restocks itself from your storage after every craft**. Costs a trickle of power. Strictly adjacent: a workbench with reach, not an ME network. ![The Access Terminal UI](https://i.imgur.com/DELKSbI.png) _One screen for the whole chest wall: count-sorted network view up top, self-restocking craft grid below, energy gauge on the right._ ## 🥊 Servo Gauntlet Can't bring the mech? Load any arm module into the **Servo Gauntlet** and run it by hand — handheld drill, quarry, blaster, fist, saber, gatling, or sprayer, powered by an internal cell you charge on a pad or any item charger. Sneak-click opens its module bay. ## 📖 Getting Started Craft the **Field Manual** — 12 in-game pages cover everything from your first chassis to the power grid. Balance knobs (health, energy costs, solar rates, and more) live in `config/mechworks.json`. *** **Requires:** Fabric Loader + Fabric API (Minecraft 1.20.1) **Optional:** Tech Reborn (cables, batteries, and chargers interoperate both ways) **License:** MIT, feel free to add to any mod packs, no need to ask!
